scenes.heading: Stop Procrastinating in 2 Minutes
scenes.say: Here is how to stop procrastinating, in just two minutes.

scenes.heading: The 2-Minute Rule
points: If it takes under 2 minutes, do it NOW
scenes.say: It's called the two minute rule. If a task takes less than two minutes, do it right now.

scenes.heading: Big Task? Shrink It.
points: Go running? Put on your shoes
scenes.say: Got a big task? Shrink it down to its first two minutes. Read one page. Put on your running shoes.

scenes.heading: Why It Works
scenes.say: Why does it work? Because starting is the hardest part. Once you begin, momentum does the rest.

scenes.heading: Try It Today! Follow for more
scenes.say: Try it today, and follow for more life hacks.
